title: Sean McVay talks Puka Nacua's game status, Aaron Donald's return & more ahead of Week 2 vs. Giants
headline: Puka Nacua is questionable for Monday night with groin soreness after sitting practice, while Aaron Donald's return is progressing well ahead of the Giants game.
summary: McVay opened with the injury report: Kinchens is out with a hamstring injury, Landman is limited, Speights is full, and Jordan Whittington is doubtful with a quad issue. Puka Nacua did not practice and is questionable, with McVay saying he has some soreness in his groin and that whether he plays is still to be determined. McVay said the Nacua issue is separate from an earlier one and that he did not feel fully like himself at a recent practice, so the team has been managing him carefully. McVay said Aaron Donald looks really good and is excited to play, and he indicated Donald's plan is to play. McVay praised Kevin Dotson and Steve Avila as productive, physical guards and included Coleman Shelton and the tackles in his praise of the interior line. He called Wesley Bailey a physical, stout player who earned his roster spot through practice and preseason play. McVay also said a player he referred to as Miles was placed on IR and had surgery that went well. He framed the Monday night game as a home opener and his 10th season as head coach.

injuries.detail: Did not practice; coach cites groin soreness and says a separate issue from earlier, with his availability still to be determined.
